instructions: Review for Helm Sports Labs (a commercial multi-sport college-athletics SaaS: GolfHelm + CoachHelm AI + BaseballHelm + Lift Lab) as a product-aware senior engineer, NOT a line-level linter. CodeRabbit owns line-level lint/style; you own the cross-file / whole-codebase view AND product awareness. Before commenting, read .greptile/rules.md and the context files in .greptile/files.json (business context, personas, jobs-to-be-done, product invariants, workflow maps, schema/feature brains). Two jobs on every PR: (1) BLOCK real problems — security/RLS/cross-tenant data isolation, service-role leakage, destructive DELETE-then-INSERT, invalid enum/pipeline-stage writes, client-side LLM calls, missing RLS on new tables, edits to historical migrations, stat/scoring math changed without tests, timezone-unsafe calendar logic; (2) SUGGEST non-blocking product enhancements (info-level) that finish a workflow, remove coach/player friction, close a competitor-parity gap, or add a missing test/telemetry lane — grounded in the business docs, concrete and few. Prioritize product/security/data-integrity findings over style.

rules.rule: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY and createAdminClient() bypass RLS and are allowed ONLY in src/lib/supabase/admin* and src/app/api/**/admin/**. Flag any other file importing or using the service-role client as a security incident.

Every CREATE TABLE must ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY and add at least one CREATE POLICY in the same migration. SECURITY DEFINER functions must SET search_path = ''. Flag any new table without RLS + policy, and any cross-team-readable policy (USING (true)) on tables holding player/coach/recruiting PII.

No DELETE-then-INSERT in any save/submit/sync path (TypeScript, SQL, or Python). Require upsert / ON CONFLICT or stage-and-swap. A wrapping transaction does not excuse the pattern. Highest-risk surfaces: roster, qualifier selections, round save, box-score save.

baseball_pipeline_stage has EXACTLY 5 values: watchlist, high_priority, offer_extended, committed, uninterested. Flag any code that writes or branches on other stage strings (e.g. contacted, campus_visit) — a write of an out-of-enum value is rejected by Postgres. src/lib/recruiting/stages.ts is a known offender.

Never call an LLM from a client component. CoachHelm composers (composeRoundReview/composeHeroNarrative/composeCoachChat) are server-only and must route through the per-coach daily budget check in src/lib/coachhelm/v3/llm/budget.ts, verify citations, and regenerate-once before template fallback.

Do not edit migrations whose timestamp prefix is <= 20260527120000 (schema baseline). Fix replay failures with a NEW forward-only migration. Override only if the PR title contains [migration-baseline-change].

All Supabase tables are golf_* or baseball_* (or helm_lifting_* for Lift Lab). Exempt: users, organizations, memberships, audit_log, feature_flags. Flag .from("coaches"/"players"/"teams"/"rounds"/"events") — an unprefixed table name usually means the RLS policy on the intended table was never checked either.

Every exported async server action must await supabase.auth.getUser() and throw on no-user BEFORE any .from()/.rpc() call; mutations must revalidatePath() after writing. Never resolve tenancy from a client-supplied teamId/coachId/playerId — resolve it server-side.

Store event timestamps in UTC; display in the team/user timezone. Flag naive Date() day-boundaries, server-timezone assumptions for today/this-week, recurrence code without a DST-boundary test, and event UIs that don't make required-vs-optional / team-vs-individual legible to a player. (One example of a broader class: apply the same rigor to any time-, money-, or count-sensitive surface.)

Imports and syncs must be idempotent: re-importing the same source updates/merges, never silently duplicates. Failed rows should be quarantined with a reason; source system, import timestamp, and confidence should be preserved, not discarded.
